system_texts: The PM will try to obtain the chip before receiving the Excel sheet.
ME will help PM to make one big LCD screen with casing around it.
All participants will enter their questionnaire responses before the next meeting.
PM will save a copy of the document.
gold_texts: The project manager will complete the final report covering the team's decisions and financial redesign, with the marketing expert assisting.
The industrial designer and user interface designer will redraw the remote to match the reduced-cost, one-control design; the recorded drawing was revised during the meeting.

The marketing expert will present the prepared evaluation procedure and lead the team's assessment of the revised design; the procedure, internal ratings and mean calculation were completed during this meeting.
